Marco R.: Heads up — ZenithBank legal is asking for our SOC 2 report and some sort of short attestation so they can approve a 3-week POC. They want NDA + limited engineer access to a sandbox. Any blockers on providing a report under NDA or a scoped attestation?
Priya S.: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report but only under an NDA (standard). We don't usually issue open-ended "bridge letters" but we can do a scoped attestation (signed by CISO) covering controls in place for the POC window.
Liam K.: POC asks: dedicated model instance (non-prod), IP allowlist, and some log access for their SREs. Also asked if Dedicated pricing applies for a short-term POC or if there's a trial rate.
Ben L.: Sales perspective — ZenithBank is enterprise, they'd accept an NDA + signed attestation. We'll need something quick (48–72h) to move the deal. Can Legal/Contracts push expedited NDA?
Contracts Bot: Uploaded template: https://files.redwood/ndas/zenithbank_draft_v2.pdf — please review. (uploaded by @contracts-bot)
Priya S.: Checklist for scoped POC attestation (what we'll confirm in the letter):
- SOC 2 Type II status: report available and can be shared under NDA.
- Data handling: POC data will not be persisted beyond 30 days and will be scoped to the sandbox project.
- Access controls: MFA + SSO enforced for all engineer accounts; IP allowlist for access to sandbox; audit logs enabled.
- Infrastructure: option for VPC peering or Dedicated instance; KMS for customer keys if they request.
Monique C.: I can sign a scoped attestation (short one-page letter) but need the POC scope clearly defined and confirm the checklist above. Also need Legal to confirm NDA language allows distribution of SOC2 report and attestation.
Liam K.: For pricing — propose no Dedicated commit for POC; we can do timeboxed Dedicated-style sandbox at a trial uplift (approx +15% on hosted rate) since they want isolated capacity. I'll draft numbers.
Marco R.: Timeline: if Legal approves NDA today and Monique signs attestation we can start infra provisioning in 48h. Zenith wants to start next Monday.
Ben L.: I'll ping Zenith to ask if the attestation + SOC2 under NDA is sufficient or if they explicitly need an external bridge letter signed by auditor. That will change path.
Priya S.: Note on "bridge letter": outside of audit firm attestation, we avoid claiming auditor-issued bridges. We can provide a Redwood-signed control statement for a defined date range only. If they insist on auditor bridge, procurement will push for completed SOC2 Type II period — that may delay.
Liam K.: Quick config snippet for the sandbox we intend to provision (for infra team):
```
project: zenith-poc-sandbox
mode: isolated-dedicated
network: ip-allowlist [1.2.3.4/32, 5.6.7.8/32]
kms: customer-managed (optional)
data_retention_days: 30
logs: enabled (readonly access via signed URL)
```
Monique C.: Also require: no upload of raw customer PII to the sandbox, redaction policy in place, and a rollback/cleanup script to wipe project at POC end — include that in the attestation scope.
Marco R.: Noted — I'll add the cleanup requirement to the SOW.
Ben L.: I'll escalate NDA to Legal and copy Monique. Priya — can your team prefill the SIG/CAIQ answers we already maintain? Zenith might run their vendor risk tool and that speeds approval.
Priya S.: Yes, we have a current SIG pack. I'll attach the CAIQ export and prefill; give me 24–48h.
Marco R.: Perfect. If we can get NDA + attestation signed by Friday, provisioning Monday, POC live next week. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Liam K.: I'll draft the trial pricing and share in this thread. :eyes:
Contracts Bot: NDA status: zenithbank_draft_v2.pdf — assigned to Legal (Monique C.).
Monique C.: Legal will review the NDA today. If language permitting SOC2 under NDA is present, I'll sign the attestation once the POC scope is finalized.
Marco R.: Great — tagging Zenith contact to confirm scope after Legal gives green light.
Ben L.: Calling out risk: if they require auditor-issued bridge letters we may need to request an exception or push timeline. I'll surface to the buyer now.
Priya S.: I'll start assembling the SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 redaction instructions. Will post the package here when ready.
Marco R.: Thanks all — keeping this thread as single source for tracking.
